Set.Author: Nikola Hristov
Set.Message:
chore(build): remove trailing whitespace in gitmodules configuration

- Eliminates trailing newline in .gitmodules configuration for Queue submodule
- Maintains consistency with Git's recommended formatting practices
- Part of ongoing codebase hygiene efforts to reduce noise in diffs

This minor formatting change improves configuration file cleanliness without affecting functionality. The Queue submodule remains a critical dependency for Land's asynchronous task processing infrastructure.

Set.Author: Nikola Hristov
Set.Message:
chore(build): update Queue submodule and track changes

- Update `Queue` submodule to commit 143abae to incorporate latest changes from upstream
- Remove `ignore = all` directive in .gitmodules to enable tracking of submodule changes

This change ensures the Land project stays aligned with the current state of the Queue dependency, which is critical for IPC message handling between Mountain and Cocoon components. Actively tracking the submodule will improve dependency management during the Electron-to-Tauri migration by ensuring all contributors use the same Queue version for:
- Reliable message queuing in the Vine IPC layer
- Consistent process management in the Track dispatcher
- Stable RPC communication between extension host and core

Set.Author: Nikola Hristov
Set.Message:
docs(license): Migrate from CC0 1.0 to Land Public License v1.0

Replaced Creative Commons Zero license with custom Land Public License (LPL-1.0) to establish project-specific governance framework. The new license:
- Implements copyleft requirements for Land project modifications while allowing combination with external works under different licenses
- Explicitly separates LPL-covered components from external dependencies in combined works
- Includes patent grants and defensive termination clauses
- Specifies Bulgarian jurisdiction for dispute resolution
- Maintains compatibility with permissive licenses (MIT/Apache) while outlining GPL/AGPL interaction
- Formalizes contribution requirements and source code distribution obligations

BREAKING CHANGE: Changes license terms from public domain dedication to reciprocal copyleft structure. All contributors must now comply with LPL-1.0 requirements for distribution and modification.

Set.Author: Nikola Hristov
Set.Message:
chore(Dependency): update Queue submodule to latest version

This updates the Queue dependency to commit ea9daf4, which provides foundational improvements for Land's IPC and process management systems. As part of the Vine IPC layer infrastructure, Queue enhancements likely contribute to:
- Improved message handling reliability between Mountain and Cocoon processes

- Preparation for upcoming work on the Cocoon extension host's process lifecycle management

This dependency update aligns with Land's core goal of maintaining a robust IPC foundation while migrating from Electron to Tauri/Rust architecture.
